newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 226,600 running bales (RB) were 37 percent above the previous week and 14 percent over the 4-week average. China (84,800 RB) was the major buyer, followed by Turkey (26,500 RB), Taiwan (24,500 RB), Japan (19,600 RB), South Korea (15,100 RB), and Indonesia (11,400 RB).
Sales of 36,400 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were for Canada (14,900 RB), Japan (10,400 RB), Indonesia (10,100 RB), and South Korea (1,000 RB).

Exports of 173,700 RB were up 60 percent from the prior week and 31 percent from the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 74 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 19 percent; and West European, 7 percent.
